## Connected component

**Glossary / Segmentation and identity**

[numeric index vector; groups in a bwconncomp struct]

A foreground voxel group connected under a specified adjacency rule.

<details>
<summary>Input layout and MATLAB lookup</summary>


```text
Inputs: { Connectivity* = numeric scalar; ImageSize* = numeric vector; NumObjects* = numeric scalar; PixelIdxList* = cell array of numeric index vectors; }
```

```matlab
entry = farmGlossary("Connected component", "Section", "Glossary");
```


</details>

<details>
<summary>Interpretation and scope</summary>


Layout applies to the component struct, not an individual raw index vector.


</details>

<summary>Input layout and MATLAB lookup</summary>
